# cloudsmith_team_members (Data Source)

Retrieve all members of a specific team within a Cloudsmith organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "org" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

data "cloudsmith_team_members" "teams" {
  organization = data.cloudsmith_organization.org.slug_perm
  team_name    = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization to which this team belongs.
- `team_name` (String) Name (slug) of the team whose members to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `members` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `role` (String)
- `user` (String)
